completion_criteria.text: hooks/lib/pre-tool-use.mjs inverted to deny-by-default inside a protected root: any resolvable token under a protected root DENIES unless the segment head is on an explicit read-only allowlist. shell-tokens.mjs left unchanged.

Both directions proven by committed tests: all 12 verified evasions (including `( rm -rf <root> )` and `sudo rm -rf <root>`) assert DENY, and the 41-command read-only corpus asserts ALLOW. Red-before/green-after evidence recorded.
The scanSegments blow-up resolved so the guard fails CLOSED on oversized or pathological input, never open, with a test asserting the fail-closed path at the boundary.
Full plugin test suite green on the branch, and a fresh code-reviewer plus security-reviewer pass over the final diff returns no CRITICAL or HIGH findings.

Branch merged to main, plugin published to the marketplace, and re-installed globally - then a live end-to-end check against the real store shows a real evasion DENIED and ordinary read commands still ALLOWED.

spine.active_goal: Items 1-2 LANDED, pushed as c25516c on fix/pre-tool-use-guard: parser deleted (5 modules, the unit/scope/overlay machinery, and the consumerless splitControl tokenizer), replaced by a parse-free substring tripwire. Item 3 per 0030: LocalDriver commit()/sync() are no-op stubs (local-driver.mjs:183-189); give it a private git repo under its data dir reusing GitRefDriver's commit-per-mutation choke point (#commitWorktree, git-ref-driver.mjs:236-247), degrading safely without git. FRESH code+security review over c25516c: prior reviews ran on the PRE-FIX diff, so criterion 4 is not yet checkable. Item 4 per 0037: only verified sandbox claims. No PR without a go.
open_risks: ITEM 4 BLOCKER per 0037: 0030 asserts sandbox denyWrite does not sandbox hooks or MCP servers, so the plugin can still write its store. Docs do NOT confirm this. If it is false, a denyWrite entry over the ledger root turns a protection into an outage. Human-run empirical test required.

Docs-verified: sandbox.filesystem.denyWrite takes an array of path globs; OS-enforced via Seatbelt (macOS) and bubblewrap (Linux/WSL2), so /bin/rm and find -delete cannot evade it; arrays MERGE across settings scopes; unsupported platforms warn and run UNSANDBOXED unless failIfUnavailable.

PROMPT FATIGUE is now the guard's real failure mode and is security-relevant. 68 formerly-allowed read-only commands now prompt, including grep -rn '_ledger' src. The prompt IS the protection, so volume that trains reflexive approval degrades it. State plainly in the README.

Under a NON-DEFAULT ledger_branch the headline gain evaporates: LEDGER_REF is hardcoded '_ledger' while ledger_branch is user-configurable via LEDGER_BRANCH. Deliberately not fixed per 0036; refs/ledger/ is the partial mitigation. MUST be documented.

COMPLETION CRITERIA NOT TOGGLED, deliberately. 1-2 are marked done but describe a deleted parser; 3 names scanSegments, now deleted; 5 asserts DENY where the tripwire answers ask. Only 4 is satisfiable as written and is NOT met: both reviews ran on the pre-fix diff. Re-derive before any DoD close.

Residual losses vs the parser, acceptable under the accident model: a symlink-aliased spelling where the root is canonical and the command names the alias; and shell quoting games. The relative-spelling and cd-then-rm gaps were CLOSED by the review fixes.

UNAUTHORIZED DEFECT, open, do not fix without explicit go: the Stop hook nags every turn (stop.mjs exits 2 unconditionally, never reads stop_hook_active). Surfaced twice this session; no user reply either time.

test/e2e/drift-signals.test.mjs can fail with 'gpg: signing failed: Cannot allocate memory' under concurrent agent load. Environmental: passes 6/6 in isolation, untouched by the diff. Re-run it alone.
